125727080.notes: This file pertains to Fedor Ignatievich Mazurchuk, born 1924, a Red Army Soldier (Кр-ц) from Rivne region, Gorokhovsky district, village Bozhekevichi. He died in battle on '13 Октября 1944 г.' The document includes processing dates of '3 сентября 44' and '3 ноября 1944'. It was addressed to the 'Млиновскому Райвоенкому' (Mlinovsky District Military Commissariat). The second page indicates the sender as 'Управление по учету погибшего и пропавшего без вести рядового и сержантского состава, Москва'. A handwritten note on the second page, dated '11-07-1944', states 'Извещение вручено Мазурчук Федору Игнатьевичу', which is prior to the recorded death date of '13 Октября 1944 г.' This suggests it might refer to an earlier event or a notification delivered to his next of kin.
